name: plus-ultra
description: Spec-driven development conventions on top of Superpowers, with portable skills and Codex lifecycle hooks for guardrails.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven development conventions for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Repo conventions for spec-driven development: specs/NNN-slug.md numbering, a spec template, and a draft -> approved -> in-progress -> done lifecycle. Includes Codex lifecycle hooks for command guardrails, verification tracking, formatting, and spec-aware session resume. Built to sit on top of Superpowers.
defaultPrompt: Create a new plus-ultra spec for this feature.
Review this branch against the in-progress plus-ultra spec.
